name: Transmutation Adept

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Always prepare these spells when you have slots of levels 1, 2, 3, 4, and 5 respectively: Jump; Spider Climb; Slow; Polymorph; Animate Objects. On your turn, a slotted Transmutation adds 5 feet times slot level to Speed until that turn ends.
